versions.changelog:
- Initial release of img2md.
- Extracts text from images (PNG, JPG, WebP, BMP, TIFF) to Markdown using OCR.
- Supports both local image files and image URLs.
- No API key or authentication required; images up to 10MB supported.
- Includes command-line usage examples and installation options (npm, uv, go).
- Applies user's language automatically in output.
